decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already captures the required FAQ explanation of wallet provisioning, mint delivery, and reward access.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already captures automatic non-custodial wallet provisioning and direct NFT delivery for Transak purchases.
The fiat mint-fulfillment decision does not change the existing mint price, revenue shares, prize-pool funding, or fiat-fee treatment.
Automatic wallet creation and NFT delivery for fiat buyers do not alter the optional mint tipping behavior.
The source message's direct prize-transfer decision is already fully represented by the existing message-184 MODIFY, including removal of the obsolete claim interaction.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already captures the specified confirmation-email contents and certificate reading actions.
The ebook reader behavior is established by a separate clause in the same message and is already represented; the fiat mint-fulfillment change adds nothing further.
The source decision concerns Transak wallet provisioning and NFT delivery, not reward routing for mints without a referral code.
The source does not change which sale types fund prize pools or how long that funding continues.
The message reiterates that the mint number is provided as the referral code but does not change its basis, permanence, or existing display locations.
Mentioning dashboard access through an email link or SIWE does not necessarily change the existing email-based dashboard authentication requirement.
The reference to on-chain fair randomness reiterates the established winner-selection behavior and does not modify its provider, execution, or eligibility rules.
